title: When the Undertow Sings
author: Isandro Sterling
blurb: Juniper Ravensworth, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
